newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil weakens slightly in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil weakens slightly in quiet market.

text.p: NWE gas oil weakened slightly on Friday in line with small benchmark IPE futures losses but traders said the market was extremely quiet.
June IPE gas oil was trading $1.0 lower at $173.25 a tonne at 1216 GMT.
Traders said business was very slow with many Germans extending Thursday's regional Corpus Christi holiday into the weekend.
"It's a typical quiet Friday, half of Germany is still on holiday and the weather's too good," one trader said.
Heating oil barge premiums stood around June IPE +50 cents/+$2.0 fob ARA for first half June and June IPE flat/$1.0 for second half June.
Diesel barge premiums were also under pressure as buyers remained elusive. Offers were heard at around June IPE +$10 fob Rotterdam, +$9 fob Flushing and +$8.50 fob Antwerp.
